Robust Video Matting (RVM) / MobileNetV3
Shanchuan Lin, Linjie Yang and contributors
https://github.com/PeterL1n/RobustVideoMatting
License: GPL-3.0; see rvm.txt.
Thru3D uses converted and optimized MNN graphs, including a project-trained
student variant. Original and derived model hashes, profiles and conversion
records are preserved in models/manifest. The bundled model is not an
unmodified upstream checkpoint.

Depth Anything V2 Small
Depth Anything contributors
https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2
https://huggingface.co/depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small
License: Apache-2.0 for the Small model; see depth.txt.
Thru3D converts the Small model to MNN and adapts graph layout, input shape and
upsampling for still-photo inference. This notice refers to Small, not
the differently licensed Base, Large or Giant checkpoints.

ZipDepth base
Fabio Tosi and contributors
https://github.com/fabiotosi92/ZipDepth
Revision: 91f3fd21e131641f51e8d35736d1958350180e3a
License: MIT; see zipdepth.txt.
Thru3D uses the base checkpoint for video stereo and portrait fine depth,
converted to MNN (FP16) at 384x224 and 512x288 input sizes.
The MNN export fuses convolutions and retains the learned global-context
weights. Convex upsampling is rewritten without a Softmax operator (per-subpixel
mean folded into the mask convolution, then Exp and 1x1 sum convolutions; the
centered logit is clamped at 8 for FP16 range), and grouped 1x1 projections run
as equivalent dense convolutions. The bundled model is not an unmodified
upstream checkpoint.
The deployment approach also references NeoNatural/xr-3d-viewer (GPL-3.0),
revision 283c0180af0f4a7c96e182bfcda7fdec12d7d143, tools/convert_zipdepth.py.
Model/source hashes and numeric validation are in models/manifest/zipdepth_video.json
and models/manifest/zipdepth_video_compat.json.
